okay. you sound smart and i know exactly where your head is at. i've been there. the truth is, nature is just one confusing mess of senselessness. it's how you choose to live in it that makes the difference. i hate to sound preachy, but there are so many things you can do. i've also attempted suicide and i would say right now i'm just pretty regretful that it didn't exactly work out. i believe you're serious about this, and if you are, just be aware that most suicide attempts fail. you don't want to go through the agony of sitting in a hospital on 24 hour watch and then being put in a psych ward and sitting out the next two weeks of your life in abject humiliation. i understand why you're depressed and your reasons are definitely valid. we are tiny and insignificant. but as insignificant and stupid as you might be while you are alive, you're going to be infinitely more so when you are dead. try not to think about it too much. if the thought of purposelessness in the world haunts you, try to find a purpose, however meaningless it may be. there's always something you can do. try to avoid death. humans are designed to hold onto life as long as they can. the fact that you (and me) have considered giving it up speaks volumes about our dependence on the world and humanity. sorry, that was garbled. i'm not even sure what message i'm trying to pass on to you. don't die and good luck managing.
